1) For SSO: we need SAML metadata (IdP/SP XML), any docs on SAML bindings you support, and a short note on session timeouts and authn context.
2) SCIM: do you support SCIM v2 for provisioning? If so, we need an outline of the attribute mapping and auth mechanism (OAuth/SCIM token).

4) SOC 2: please confirm the expected availability date for Type II and whether your process includes encryption-at-rest verification and change-management controls.

Procurement looped in for the BAA and contract timeline. If Marissa can provide the SSO/SCIM artifacts and a suggested time for a 30-min security walkthrough, we'll add it to our intake.

Subject: IAM evidence and suggested walkthrough times

Hi Lauren — copying the items below and attaching the artifacts we typically provide during security intake. See the short answers inline and the attachments for the technical artifacts.

1) SAML / SSO
- Attached: sso-saml-metadata.xml (SP metadata), redwood-sso-overview.pdf (contains supported bindings and session guidance).
- We support SAML 2.0 (HTTP-Redirect, HTTP-POST). Default session timeout is configurable by customer; default on hosted is 8 hours. We recommend enforcing SAML AuthnContext class comparison if you require MFA.

2) SCIM provisioning
- Yes, we support SCIM v2 for provisioning. Auth is via bearer token (customer-managed token scoped to SCIM endpoints). Attribute mapping doc is in the SSO overview (email, name, groups, role). We support incremental syncs and user disable/enable flows.

3) RBAC / admin controls
- Attached: iam-admin-controls-screenshots.zip (role assignment UI and audit log snippets).
- Super-admin role: full tenant config + billing. Admin roles can be scoped to per-team or per-project. Audit logs capture admin actions (role changes, API key creation) and are retained per our retention policy; for hosted customers default retention is 90 days (longer retention available as an add-on).

4) SOC 2 Type II
- Confirmed: full SOC 2 Type II for our platform is expected to be available under NDA by 2026-07-10. It includes encryption-at-rest verification and change-management controls; I can provide the control matrix once the report is released.

Attachments included: sso-saml-metadata.xml, iam-admin-controls-screenshots.zip.

Suggested slots for a 30-min security walkthrough this week: Wed 6/17 10:00-10:30 PT, Thu 6/18 14:00-14:30 PT. If none of those work, propose alternatives and we'll accommodate.

Thanks — happy to hop on a call and walk through the artifacts with your security team.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Security & Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference
